title: Roasted Salmon with Orange-Ginger Glaze
description: A simple orange juice, balsamic vinegar, and ginger mixture are all it takes to transform roasted salmon into a gourmet extravaganza for any dinner party.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh ginger root
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Line a medium baking dish with parchment paper.
Place orange juice in a small saucepan over medium-low heat. Cook and stir until thickened and reduced by about half, 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool.
Stir balsamic vinegar and ginger into cooled orange juice.
Place salmon fillet skin-side down in the prepared baking dish. Season with salt and pepper. Cover with 1/2 of the orange juice mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10 to 15 minutes. Brush with remaining orange juice mixture and continue baking until fish flakes easily with a fork, 10 to 15 minutes.
